svg.title: In 20.1% of repos with both files, CLAUDE.md never points to AGENTS.md
svg.desc: What a root CLAUDE.md does with the AGENTS.md beside it, in the 2,968 census repos that have both. Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when there is no CLAUDE.md.
